tool_arguments_ref.summary: PGS005206 (reported trait: Bone mineral density; the linked source GWAS GCST005348 is Total body bone mineral density) was applied with its published weights (81 variants, GRCh38 harmonized scoring file matching its approved SHA-256 pin) to synthetic effect-allele dosages for 20 individuals. All 81 variants were matched, coverage was 1.0 for every individual, and QC status was PASS for 20 of 20 individuals. The column order of the input file was rewritten by header name only, and all 1620 cells were verified identical to the original. Raw scores are in artifacts/prs_scores_1.csv. Limitations: the data are synthetic; the score's own trait fields do not state a skeletal site (total-body is inferred from the linked source GWAS); the derivation of the 81 weights was not verified, and 8 of 12 weights that overlap the GWAS Table 1 differ in magnitude with the same allele and sign; predictive validity and ancestry transferability could not be assessed because the target data have no phenotypes or ancestry; the only catalog evaluation is a single European cohort of children (Generation R, n=3470, mean age 9.77 years); and 24 variants have an ambiguous other allele and 5 are palindromic, which dosages coded by effect allele cannot test.
